Still in the optimal zone! Here's the latest status and a summary of my capabilities:

---

## 📊 Current Context Status

```xml
<context_status>
  <tokens_used>793</tokens_used>
  <total_capacity>200,000</total_capacity>
  <utilization>0.40%</utilization>
  <zone>OPTIMAL ✅</zone>
  <recommendation>Context is healthy. No action needed.</recommendation>
</context_status>
```

> 📈 **Growth Trend:** Our conversation is steadily growing — `0.01% → 0.17% → 0.40%` — but we're still far from the 40% threshold that would trigger compression. Plenty of room to work!

---

## 🧠 Context Management Capabilities

I operate under **Horthy's 40% Rule**: keep utilization below 40% to stay out of the "Dumb Zone" where response quality degrades.

### 🔧 My Four Core Tools

```xml
<tools>
  <tool name="check_context_budget">
    <purpose>Monitor utilization and zone status</purpose>
    <trigger>Start of complex tasks; periodically throughout</trigger>
  </tool>
  <tool name="compress_history">
    <purpose>Rolling summarization — old messages summarized, recent kept verbatim</purpose>
    <trigger>Utilization approaching 40%</trigger>
  </tool>
  <tool name="hierarchical_compress">
    <purpose>Three-tier age-based compression for heavy-duty needs</purpose>
    <trigger>Long conversations with deep history</trigger>
  </tool>
  <tool name="retrieve_relevant">
    <purpose>Smart memory search — fetch only the most relevant past context</purpose>
    <trigger>Memory-heavy tasks requiring recall of specific past info</trigger>
  </tool>
</tools>
```

### 🗂️ Compression Tiers (hierarchical_compress)

```xml
<compression_tiers>
  <tier name="Recent" turns="0–9">Kept fully verbatim</tier>
  <tier name="Medium" turns="10–30">Condensed paragraph summaries</tier>
  <tier name="Old" turns="30+">Key facts only</tier>
</compression_tiers>
```

### ⚙️ Workflow

```xml
<workflow>
  <step order="1">Check budget at the start of complex tasks</step>
  <step order="2">Compress proactively before reaching 40%</step>
  <step order="3">Retrieve only what's needed for memory-heavy tasks</step>
  <step order="4">Use XML formatting for structured outputs</step>
</workflow>
```

---

We're at just **0.40%** with ~**199,207 tokens** remaining — still an enormous amount of headroom. Keep the questions coming! 🚀
